title: cheaper-inference/OmniRoute: one local endpoint in front of the model accounts you already have
friendlyTitle: cheaper-inference/OmniRoute: one local address in front of the model accounts you already have
summary: OmniRoute is a local gateway that coding tools can call as one endpoint. The project says it routes across many providers, including free tiers, and falls back when a quota runs out. The README also claims large token savings from compression. Those figures are the project's own. MIT. GitHub's TypeScript trending list showed 390 stars today, and about 83,900 in total. The tagged release is v3.8.52, from 19 October. The release branch had commits on 2 November.
friendlySummary: OmniRoute is a local gateway. Coding tools can call it as one address. The project says it sends each request to one of many providers, including free plans, and switches when a quota runs out. The README also claims large savings from shortening prompts. Those numbers are the project's own. The license is MIT. GitHub's TypeScript trending list showed 390 stars today, and about 83,900 in total. The tagged release is v3.8.52, from 19 October. The release branch had new commits on 2 November.
whyItMatters: Use it when Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or a similar tool should share one local address, and you want a second provider when the first quota is spent. A free tier is still a quota, and it has to be an account you are allowed to use. The README's promise that you will not hit a limit is a slogan, not a term of service.
